Maps can use recognized notification arrows or explicit text. Roundabouts require an explicit exit number. Unknown or conflicting guidance is not sent. ABRP requires explicit text.

If Android says “App was denied access”, open App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then return and enable notification access. This lets Satellite read navigation notifications from your selected source. If the option is missing or disabled, the box firmware may restrict access; the app cannot grant it itself.
